articles.title: A Plant That Vanished for 60 Years Just Popped Up Again!
articles.summary: A plant no one had seen since 1967 was found in Australia by a bird helper who snapped a photo. Scientists thought it was extinct, but now they can protect it.

articles.title: Meet the NASA Scientist Teaching Astronauts to Be Moon Detectives!
articles.summary: Cindy Evans trains Artemis astronauts to read the Moon's rocks like a storybook. Her geology lessons help them spot clues about ancient lava and craters during their mission.

articles.title: Why Are States Fighting Over Student Loans for Nurses?
articles.summary: A new rule limits how much money grad students can borrow for nursing and other healthcare degrees. 24 states are suing, saying it will make the nurse shortage worse.
